subject: Animation
title: Scooby-Doo: The Mystery Formula
description: Learn Scooby-Doo: The Mystery Formula in one minute.

hook.text: Scooby-Doo debuted in 1969 and has been continuously reinvented for over fifty years without ever leaving TV.

buildup.text: CBS executives wanted a non-violent cartoon. Hanna-Barbera pitched teens solving mysteries with a dog.

discovery.text: The formula — mystery, chase, unmasking — was so repeatable that it became the longest-running cartoon format.

twist.text: Scooby was almost a sheepdog named Too Much. A last-minute network note changed the breed and the name.

climax.text: Scooby-Doo's formula has survived five decades, hundreds of episodes, and dozens of reboots.

punchline.text: A cowardly dog with a snack problem became immortal.

quiz.question: Why has Scooby-Doo lasted for over fifty years?
options: The animation quality improved dramatically each decade
Its repeatable mystery-chase-unmasking formula proved endlessly adaptable to new generations
It switched from animation to live-action early on
